description: This file contains utility functions for converting OpenAI chat tools and tool choices into Anthropic's format, including handling different tool types and parallel call options.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolToAnthropic
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI ChatCompletionTool object to an Anthropic Tool format, extracting name, description, and input schema.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolsToAnthropic
methods.description: Converts an array of OpenAI ChatCompletionTools into an array of Anthropic Tool objects.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolChoiceToAnthropic
methods.description: Maps OpenAI's tool_choice parameter to Anthropic's format, handling string and object types, with optional parallel call control.
